review_status.description: Use performed only after completing substantive review of the reviewable exact subject. Partial and not_performed cannot carry a merits decision.

subject_reviewable.description: True only when the exact bound subject was available and inspectable. A merits decision requires true.

substantive_merit_evaluated.description: True only when correctness and requested review dimensions were substantively evaluated. A merits decision requires true.

acknowledged_material_digests.description: The exact material digests actually inspected. Performed review requires the complete supplied set; not_performed requires an empty array.

decision.description: approved, changes_requested, and blocked are merits decisions requiring performed review, a reviewable subject, and substantive evaluation. approved forbids blocking findings and required_next_actions. invalid_input is not_performed diagnostic output.

required_action.description: The concrete remediation for a blocking finding; a recommendation when reviewer_disposition is advisory.

observations.description: Non-authority-bearing advisory observations and downstream-workflow notes. Observations cannot require remediation of the current reviewed subject or change the decision.

required_next_actions.description: Concrete remediation required on the current reviewed subject before it may advance. This array must be empty when decision is approved.

limitations.description: Material limitations on review completeness. Partial or not_performed output requires at least one limitation and cannot authorize a merits decision.

suggestion.description: A non-blocking suggestion, or null when there is no suggestion. It is not current-subject remediation.
